title: Astro Portal saved framing
description:
The persisted shape of a saved framing, stored at plan item target.framing. `center` is fixed at the moment the framing is added and is never rewritten by a later catalogue refresh; `savedAt` records that moment.

A simple (non-mosaic) framing is centre + orientation only — its field is always the field of whatever equipment draws it (the plan's, inside a plan), never a stored value here, and it is never split into panels. A mosaic framing additionally stores the sky AREA it must cover (`mosaic.widthDegrees`/`heightDegrees`) and the requested panel overlap (`mosaic.overlapPercent`) — NEVER a column/row count: the panel grid is always recomputed by `mosaicGrid` (`packages/astro-core/src/mosaic-grid.ts`) from that area, the overlap and the field of whichever equipment is currently drawing the framing (the reference equipment in the creation modal, the plan's own equipment inside a plan), so the same framing keeps covering the same sky regardless of the telescope used.

`equipment` is the framing's `referenceEquipment`: INDICATIVE only, used to draw the frame in the creation modal and to render the library preview. Inside a plan the frame is always drawn with the plan's own equipment; a mismatch is a display-time warning, never a schema concern.

mosaic.description: Amendment A2: the sky area a mosaic framing covers and its requested overlap. No column/row count is ever stored here — see this schema's top-level description.
